purpose: Predeclare the feature families, candidate architectures, baselines, validation design, and promotion gates for the clean unified-development corpus before any astrology feature generation or model scoring on that corpus.

primary_task.unit: same-subject same-axis positive-year versus negative-year pair
primary_task.outcome: positive year should receive the higher model score

baselines.name: AGE_YOUNGER_FIXED
baselines.description: Always predicts the younger/calendar-earlier event year as positive.

baselines.name: AGE_LATER_FIXED
baselines.description: Always predicts the later event year as positive.

baselines.name: NUISANCE_AGE_AXIS
baselines.description: Age/year-gap plus axis metadata only. No astrology features.

baselines.name: CONTROL_FIXED
baselines.description: Current production annual Control score (candle.close); no refit.

winner_eligible_architectures.name: TG10_STEM_BRANCH_L2
winner_eligible_architectures.features: Exact 10 Ten-God encodings for Daewoon/Sewoon stems plus branch hidden-stem Ten-God distributions, generated with the frozen production feature lineage.
winner_eligible_architectures.reason: The prior V4 diagnostic showed richer exact Ten-God stem+branch representation recovered relative to TG5, but it was not previously validated as predictive.

winner_eligible_architectures.name: ALL_L2
winner_eligible_architectures.features: All preregistered astrology features available from the frozen V4 feature generator, excluding production Control, nuisance-only metadata, collection-origin metadata, labels, and any post-outcome information.
winner_eligible_architectures.reason: Tests whether a broad but low-variance linear astrology representation is useful.

winner_eligible_architectures.name: ALL_ELASTICNET_AUTO
winner_eligible_architectures.features: Same ALL astrology feature universe as ALL_L2.
winner_eligible_architectures.selection_rule: Choose hyperparameters only inside each outer-training split by inner subject-level CV.
winner_eligible_architectures.reason: Retains the prior sparse-selection hypothesis while forcing all selection to occur inside nested CV; prior ElasticNet instability is not treated as evidence of a winner.

actions: No feature/weight/model addition after seeing unified-corpus performance.
No coefficient hand-tuning on the 101-pair corpus.
No opening NEW_CONFIRM, Validation_B, Public_CHECK, or Public_FINAL.
No changing event labels, pair membership, or axis assignment after feature generation starts.

outer.rule: No subject may appear in both train and test within an outer split.

rules.axis_floor_diagnostic: No axis should be catastrophically inverted; report each axis separately.

tie_break: Prefer the simpler/more interpretable architecture when empirical differences are negligible

decision_rule.if_one_or_more_survive: Freeze the highest-ranked survivor as the development architecture. Do not tune it again on this corpus. Then construct a completely new, prospectively collected GOLD holdout under one frozen collection protocol and score the frozen architecture and Production Control once.
decision_rule.if_none_survive: Do not open a holdout. Conclude that the current preregistered astrology representations did not demonstrate sufficient improvement over Control/nuisance on this corpus; diagnose representation or collect more development data without post-hoc winner creation.
